market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil above $100 and 10Y near 5% create stagflationary pressure. Dow 3-day slide likely extends unless Iran de-escalates. Bond selloff may pause on Fed intervention signals but Bessent's credibility is damaged. Expect 5-8% equity drawdown risk in 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (Google $15B, Nvidia ecosystem) and Apple hardware restart support 12-month equity recovery. However, sustained $100+ oil and 5% yields cap multiple expansion. Structural shifts in crypto/fintech regulation and China industrial policy create sector rotation opportunities. Bull market intact but choppy (per Seeking Alpha thesis).
